messages:
maria: quick heads-up — the deprecation banner on /docs/cli-reference points at /old-cli which 404s in prod. link scanner flagged it as an orphan/broken link. @docs-bot posted the scan results.
docs-bot: Automated scan #3921: 1 broken link, 1 orphaned anchor. Report: https://kb.internal/scan/3921 (created 2026-03-18)
maria: can someone claim ownership so this doesn’t sit in the backlog? it’s a tiny fix but we should choose redirect vs remove.
sachin: i can do the docs side quick PR. question — do we want to redirect /old-cli -> /cli/migration or remove banner link and point to migration doc inline?
devon: who currently 'owns' cli-reference? thought that lived in platform docs but not 100% sure. @olivia do you recall the handoff?
olivia: that section was migrated from integrations last quarter. happy to own this. my preference: redirect for existing external links + update banner to point to /cli/migration. keeps SEO and avoids surprise 404s.
ryan: SGTM. redirect rule is trivial. example (Netlify _redirects):
```
/old-cli  /cli/migration  301!
```
I'll do a quick review once you open the redirect PR, @olivia.
sachin: ok i'll prepare a tiny docs PR to update the banner target and the inline migration link. sed snippet to update frontmatter banner href if anyone wants to run locally:
```
# replace banner.link: 
# sed -i "s|banner:.*|banner:\n  link: \"/cli/migration\"|" docs/cli-reference.mdx
```
maria: perfect. plan then: @olivia opens infra/redirect PR targeting the redirects repo, @sachin opens docs PR to update the mdx banner, @ryan reviews redirect, @maria will re-run the KB index after merges. anything else? :thumbsup:
olivia: assigning now, will aim for EOD.
ryan: will review as soon as it lands.
sachin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/3124 — small change, adds test for canonical link. marking as WIP until redirect is merged.
maria: thanks everyone — keeping this one low friction. ping me if either PR blocks deployment. (reacts :eyes:)
